_comment: Build configuration: emits dist/ with declarations from src/ only, so tests never end up in the build output. src/testing holds the harnesses and the seed data: it is type-checked with the sources by tsconfig.json, and most of it is emitted, because the E2E harness of task 21.1 reaches the seed scenarios as a compiled CLI (dist/testing/e2e-seed.js). The one file excluded by name is postgres-harness.ts, which imports vitest and @testcontainers/postgresql — devDependencies that must not be reachable from the built API_Service.
